caption: The drawing features a cross and its supporting base against a plain background. The cross is situated in the upper central area of the image and is rendered in brown. It consists of four parallel lines intersecting horizontally and vertically, with ornate, symmetrical decorative patterns at the ends of each arm, forming triangular and curvilinear shapes. Below the cross, there are two symmetrical spirals, also in brown, extending outward from the bottom of the cross. The supporting base of the cross is drawn in blue, and it consists of a flaring pedestal that widens toward the bottom and sits on a rectangular platform with a defined edge. The lower part of the pedestal and platform is less detailed and lightly sketched, with the primary focus on the upper portion near the cross. The background is uncolored and unadorned, providing a neutral context for the objects depicted.
title: Cross
